name: n8n-nodes-g3months-google-places
description: n8n community node for Google Places API

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = 'nodes/GooglePlaces/google-places.svg'; const dest = 'dist/nodes/GooglePlaces/google-places.svg'; if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest), { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync(src, dest); console.log('Icon copied successfully!'); }"
